title: 第 9章 本性难移第10 章 修习道法
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 巨虎离去之后，三人便在潭边为那株蕴灵草寻觅合适的移栽处。
静慧起初还拿着花铲帮忙刨了几下土，但不多时便耐不住性子，眼珠子骨碌碌转着往林子深处瞄。
“我去瞧瞧那树野柿子熟了没！去去就回！”
她没头没脑丢下一句。
也不等清逸答应，提着长剑“嗖”地一声钻进林子，身影迅速隐没在斑驳树影之中。
清逸望着她消失的方向，无奈摇头，倒也没太担心：
“由她去吧，这附近她熟。我们抓紧将草种下。”
两人选了一处离潭边稍有几尺，地势略高的缓坡。
沈回用花铲小心挖出一个浅坑，清逸则仔细地将那株蕴灵草放入其中，再覆上从旁处取来的松软泥土，轻轻压实。
“好了，接下来需得稍作布置，遮掩一番，免得被山中鸟兽当成零嘴给啄了去。”
清逸说着，开始从旁边捡拾一些大小适中的石块。
沈回起初在旁边看着，只见清逸将石块围绕新栽的蕴灵草摆了一圈，并不甚紧密。
随后他退开两步，右手掐了个简单的法诀，口中念念有词。
随着咒文诵念，清逸指尖开始泛起一层微弱的土黄色微光。
那些原本散落的石块，表面似乎开始变得有些“软化”。
边缘与地面接触处，竟缓慢地“流淌”起来，彼此靠拢粘连。
只是这过程极其缓慢。
沈回盯了好一会儿，才勉强看出那一圈石块正在逐渐“长”到一起，形成一个粗糙的环形石围。
看了一阵，沈回渐觉无趣，目光不由得飘向氤氲着雾气的温泉潭。
清逸似乎察觉到了他的心思。
他一边维持着法诀，一边头也不回地说道：“师弟若觉无聊，可在附近随意走走，只是莫要走远。或者……”
他顿了顿，“这温泉水质特殊，泡上一泡，于舒缓筋骨也有些益处。”
泡温泉？
沈回眼睛一亮。
他上辈子社畜一个，温泉旅游是他从未体验过的奢侈。
这辈子穿越过来，更是连热水澡都还没洗上一次。
而且，师兄说这水“灵气浓郁”，或许对修炼也有助益？
想到这里他不再犹豫，给清逸说了一声，径直来到潭边。
褪去身上的灰布道袍和粗布中衣，整齐叠放在一块干燥的石头上。
初冬的山风拂过裸露的皮肤，激起一阵寒栗。
他不敢耽搁，小心踏入温热的潭水中。
水温恰到好处，浸没全身的瞬间，一股暖意从四肢百骸升起，顷刻便驱散了凛冽寒意。
沈回靠在潭边一块被水流冲刷得光滑的石头上，长长舒了口气。
“舒服。不过这感觉……好像和大澡堂子也没太大差别。”
他低声咕哝，随即又自嘲地笑了笑，“区别还是有的，至少这里头没人撒尿。”
说着，他鬼使神差地捧起一汪潭水，凑到嘴边尝了一口。
水质清冽，有股说不清的味道，似乎……还行？
content_en:
After the giant tiger left, the three of them searched for a suitable transplanting place for the spirit-containing grass by the pond.
At first, Jinghui helped dig the soil a few times with a garden shovel, but soon she lost her temper and looked deep into the forest with her eyes.
"I'm going to see if the persimmons are ripe! I'll be back soon!"
She dropped a sentence without thinking.
Without waiting for Qingyi to agree, he swooped into the forest with a long sword, and his figure quickly disappeared into the mottled shadows of the trees.
Qingyi looked at the direction in which she disappeared and shook her head helplessly, not too worried:
"Let her go, she's familiar with this area. Let's plant the grass quickly."
The two chose a gentle slope a few feet away from the edge of the pool and with slightly higher terrain.
Shen Hui carefully dug a shallow pit with a flower shovel, while Qingyi carefully placed the Yunling grass into it, then covered it with soft soil taken from the side and compacted it gently.
"Okay, now we need to make some arrangements and cover it up to avoid being pecked by the birds and beasts in the mountains."
Qingyi said, and began to pick up some rocks of moderate size from the side.
Shen Hui watched from the side at first and saw Qingyi placing the stones in a circle around the newly planted Yunling grass, not very closely.
Then he took two steps back, made a simple magic formula with his right hand, and muttered something.
As the mantra was recited, Qingyi's fingertips began to glow with a faint earthy yellow shimmer.
The surface of the originally scattered stones seemed to have begun to "soften" a little.
Where the edge touches the ground, it slowly "flows" and sticks to each other.
It's just that the process is extremely slow.
Shen Hui stared for a long time, and then he could barely see that the circle of stones was gradually "growing" together, forming a rough ring of stones.
After watching it for a while, Shen Hui gradually felt bored, and his eyes couldn't help but drift towards the mist-filled hot spring pool.
Qingyi seemed to be aware of his thoughts.
While maintaining the technique, he said without looking back: "Junior brother, if you feel bored, you can walk around at will, but don't go too far. Or..."
He paused and said, "The water quality of this hot spring is special. Taking a dip in it is also good for soothing your muscles and bones."
Soak in a hot spring?
Shen Hui's eyes lit up.
He was a socialite in his previous life, and traveling to hot springs was a luxury he had never experienced before.
In this lifetime, I have not even had a hot bath.
Moreover, the senior brother said that this water is "rich in spiritual energy", maybe it is also helpful for cultivation?
Thinking of this, he no longer hesitated, told Qingyi, and went straight to the edge of the pool.
He took off his gray preaching robe and coarse cloth jacket and neatly folded them on a dry stone.
The early winter mountain wind blew over the exposed skin, causing a shiver.
He did not dare to delay and carefully stepped into the warm pool.
The temperature of the water was just right. The moment the whole body was immersed, a warmth rose from the limbs and bones, instantly dispelling the coldness.
Shen Hui leaned against a stone smoothed by the water and let out a long sigh of relief.
"Comfortable. But this feeling... doesn't seem to be much different from a big bathhouse."
He muttered under his breath, then smiled to himself, "There is still a difference, at least no one is peeing here."
As he spoke, he cleverly picked up a pool of water and brought it to his mouth to take a sip.
The water quality is clear, but there is an indescribable smell. It seems... not bad?
